claim: Epona combines history-conditioned spatiotemporal features with separate prediction heads for frames and motion plans.
limitations: Published diagram, not a model rerun. Photos remain independent; existing formula glyphs and detailed icon paths are locally resolved outlines, not editable mathematical expressions. Some gradients are approximated with solid fills and text uses substitute metrics.
